nodes.proximate_text: The cause of this indication is attributed to pre-existing surface or near-surface defects in the EFR weld material, originating from fabrication, based on previous operating experience at Byron Station. Fabrication-related porosity from welding Alloy 52M is a known phenomenon in the industry. These existing surface-level pores can slightly enlarge due to thermal and pressure-induced stresses during plant operation.
